name: Mascarene Petrel
rangeDescription: Réunion (mascarene islands); ranges adjacent indian ocean
description: An entirely dark petrel that usually has a cross-like shape in flight. Note the large, square head, the thick bill, and the long rear.

name: Papuan Cicadabird
rangeDescription: Montane forest of new guinea, including raja ampat islands (off western new guinea) and yapen (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A medium-sized bird of foothill and lower montane forest. Uniform slaty gray with a black edge to the wing and black tail tip.

name: Collared Warbling Finch
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of southwestern ecuador and western peru
description: Handsome finch-like bird found in dry habitats of western Peru and western Ecuador. Male has a black breast and face mask that stand out against his white throat, eyebrow, and belly.

name: Lesser Jacana
rangeDescription: Lakes, ponds and marshes of sub-saharan africa
description: Very small and generally uncommon jacana. Adults show rufous on the crown, breast sides, rump, and tail.

name: Rodrigues Fody
rangeDescription: Rodrigues (eastern mascarene islands)
description: A sparrow-like weaver. The mostly yellow breeding males are distinctive, but females and non-breeding males are drab.

name: Hispaniolan Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Hispaniola and beata island
description: A noisy and gregarious woodpecker that inhabits most wooded habitats. It is a striking species with a bold yellow-and-black barred back, a red crown, and a gray face with staring yellow eye.

name: Pied Oystercatcher
rangeDescription: Coastal australia including tasmania, and southern new guinea, aru, and kai islands
description: Heavy-set shorebird with long, thick reddish bill, black and white plumage, and thick pale-pink feet and legs. Usually coastal, but sometimes found on wetter pastures close to the coast.

name: Collared Crow
rangeDescription: Central and eastern china to northern vietnam; hainan and taiwan
description: By far the most distinctive crow of farmland, fields, and other open spaces: adults black with white hindneck connecting to white breast band. Superficially similar to adult Daurian Jackdaw, but the latter is more compact and smaller, with pale plumage extending through the belly.

name: Spotted Whistling-Duck
rangeDescription: Sulawesi to new guinea, bismarck archipelago, and southern philippines
description: Small whistling-duck with strongly pale-spotted neck and flanks, dark bill, and gray face. Similar to Wandering Whistling-Duck, but lacks warm rusty coloring, and has pale-spotted rather than dark-spotted breast.

name: Yellow-eared Bulbul
rangeDescription: Highlands of sri lanka
description: Medium-sized, plump green bulbul with a yellow belly and distinctive head pattern with yellow tufts behind each eye, white tufts above each eye, and white horns sticking up from the base of the bill. Found in small parties in the canopy of hill forests and adjacent woods and gardens.

name: Black-capped Rufous-Warbler
rangeDescription: Sierra leone to southeastern guinea, liberia, ivory coast, and ghana
description: Unusual and handsome forest-dwelling warbler. Mostly rufous-brown, with a black head and a black stripe onto the center of the belly.

name: Golden White-eye
rangeDescription: Central and southern northern mariana islands (saipan and aguijan)
description: A beautiful, unique, entirely yellowish white-eye. Bright golden yellow on the head with a paler eye-ring, yellowish-green wings, and a darker orange-yellow coloring below.

name: Uluguru Mountain Greenbul
rangeDescription: Northeastern tanzania (uluguru mountains)
description: A medium-sized greenbul with a dark cap, an otherwise gray head and underparts, and an olive-green back. Uncommon, inconspicuous, and local in montane forest in the Uluguru Mountains of Tanzania.

name: Casqued Cacique
rangeDescription: Tropical eastern ecuador, eastern peru, northwestern bolivia (northern la paz), and far southwestern brazil (amazonas)
description: Large red-brown cacique with a distinctive yellow helmeted bill. Yellow-olive throat and breast contrast with rich red-brown upper parts; in flight, tail is bright yellow with a central olive stripe.

name: Brown-throated Barbet
rangeDescription: Montane forest of western java
description: Unique large barbet of western Java. Leaf-green with a dark bill and an earth-brown head.

name: Tanimbar Eclectus
rangeDescription: Tanimbar islands (arafura sea)
description: Robust, big-headed, and rather short-tailed parrot endemic to the Tanimbar Islands, where it inhabits lowland and foothill forests. Male bright green with red underwings and orange bill, female bright red with dark underwings and bill.

name: Carunculated Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Obi (north-central moluccas)
description: A unique small, colorful fruit-dove confined to Obi island. Pale gray head contrasts with mostly emerald-green body, except for gray markings on the wings and back, a deep maroon belly patch, and a lemon-yellow vent and undertail.

name: Norfolk Robin
rangeDescription: Norfolk island
description: Learn about Norfolk Robin: explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Tamaulipas Pygmy-Owl
rangeDescription: Northeastern mexico (southwestern tamaulipas, eastern san luis potosí, and northern hidalgo)
description: Very small owl of tropical forest in the foothills of northeast Mexico where it is endemic. Favors forest canopy and is rarely seen, but sometimes hunts low at edges; active in the daytime.

name: Sprague's Pipit
rangeDescription: Prairies and plains of north america; winters to southern mexico
description: Buffy songbird that often stays hidden among grasses except when singing. Breeds on grassy prairies; winters in similar open habitats farther south.
